home.meta_description: Dárkomat helps families share wishes and give better gifts.
home.title: Better gifts. Fewer guesses.
home.subtitle: Dárkomat helps families share what they really want, so everyone can give a gift that makes someone happy.
home.preview_item_1_detail: A pair I have been looking at
home.steps_title: Three simple steps to better gifts.
home.step_1_text: Start a private family group and invite the people who matter.
home.step_2_text: Save gifts you would genuinely like, with links and useful details.
home.step_3_text: Family members can reserve a gift privately, so surprises stay surprises.
home.why_title: Less guessing. More genuinely good gifts.
home.feature_1_text: The person receiving the gift does not need to see who reserved it.
home.feature_2_text: Add a shop link, description or anything that helps someone choose well.
home.feature_3_text: Keep family wishes together instead of spreading them across messages and notes.
home.cta_text: Create a family wishlist and stop guessing what to buy.
home.footer_note: A simple place for better gifts.
